mapper.sql: r.id, r.batch_id, b.order_no, b.submitted_by_customer_id AS buyer_customer_id, buyer.nickname AS buyer_nickname, b.participant_count, b.payable_amount, b.payment_status AS batch_payment_status, r.customer_id, c.customer_no, c.nickname, c.real_name, r.session_id, s.session_number, s.name AS session_name, COALESCE(r.unit_price,s.standard_price) AS standard_price, r.registration_status, r.payment_status, r.registration_source, r.registered_at, r.session_referrer_customer_id, ref.nickname AS referrer_nickname, r.return_primary_trigger, r.return_trigger_note, r.attribution_source, r.remark, r.revision
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ql_registration r INNER JOIN ql_customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id INNER JOIN ql_session s ON s.id = r.session_id LEFT JOIN ql_registration_batch b ON b.id = r.batch_id LEFT JOIN ql_customer buyer ON buyer.id = b.submitted_by_customer_id LEFT JOIN ql_customer ref ON ref.id = r.session_referrer_customer_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.session_id AS sessionId, b.submitted_by_customer_id AS buyerCustomerId, b.payment_status AS paymentStatus, b.payable_amount AS payableAmount FROM ql_registration_batch b WHERE b.id = #{batchId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM ql_registration WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
